name: voaice
description: voaice — the voice of an AI service. Spectrometer, frequency manipulation, oscilloscope and TTS as an agnostic, in-house Node.js + d3 module. Separated from faicey (the FACE) so voice and face are independent peers.
//deps: Core DSP (FFT, spectrometer, frequency manipulation) is IN-HOUSE with zero external deps. d3 powers the oscilloscope. Optional analysers (meyda/audiomotion) and TTS I/O load lazily only when present — isolated builds stay minimal.
author: Professor Codephreak <rage.pythai.net>
